Build the A/B testing feature for QuizSnap:
1. Service: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/services/ab-test.server.ts`
2. Page: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.ab-tests.tsx`

Read the existing `app.ab-tests.tsx` first to see what exists. Then rebuild/create properly.

## Database Schema
```prisma
model ABTest {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  quizId        String
  shop          String
  name          String
  status        String    @default("draft")  // draft | running | completed | paused
  variants      String    @default("[]")     // JSON: [{id, name, quizId, description}]
  trafficSplit  String    @default("{}")     // JSON: {variantId: percentage, ...}
  winnerVariant String?
  startedAt     DateTime?
  endedAt       DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
  quiz          Quiz      @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([quizId])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}
```

NOTE: The ABTest model may NOT exist in the actual schema.prisma yet. Check `prisma/schema.prisma` first. If ABTest model is missing, add it. Run `npx prisma db push` after adding.

## Service (ab-test.server.ts):
```typescript
import db from "../db.server";

export async function getABTests(shop: string)
export async function getABTestById(id: string, shop: string)
export async function createABTest(shop: string, data: { name: string; quizId: string })
export async function updateABTest(id: string, shop: string, data: {...})
export async function startABTest(id: string, shop: string)
export async function pauseABTest(id: string, shop: string)
export async function completeABTest(id: string, shop: string, winnerVariant: string)
export async function deleteABTest(id: string, shop: string)
export async function assignVariant(testId: string, sessionId: string): // deterministic hash-based assignment
```

## Page (app.ab-tests.tsx):
- Auth: `authenticate.admin(request)` in loader + action
- Loader: Load all A/B tests for shop with quiz titles
- Plan gate: This is a Pro feature. Check subscription plan. If not Pro/Enterprise, show upgrade prompt using PlanGate component (import from `../components/shared/PlanGate.tsx`)

### UI:
- Page title: "A/B Tests"
- Primary action: "Create test" button
- If no tests: EmptyState with "Run your first A/B test" message
- Test list: IndexTable with columns: Name, Quiz, Status (badge), Variants, Started, Actions
- Create test: Modal with name + quiz selector (Select from shop's quizzes)
- Status badges: draft=attention, running=success, completed=info, paused=warning

### Actions:
- create: Create new A/B test
- start: Start test
- pause: Pause test
- delete: Delete test with confirmation

### Architecture Rules:
- `authenticate.admin(request)` first
- Shop-scoped queries
- Polaris v13 only
- Toast on every mutation
- SkeletonPage for HydrateFallback
- EmptyState when no tests
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- Import boundary from `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server`
- Use `data()` from react-router for error responses

WRITE both files. If ABTest model needs to be added to schema, also update `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/prisma/schema.prisma`.

## What was built

### Schema: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/prisma/schema.prisma`

Added the `ABTest` model at the end and the `abTests ABTest[]` relation back-reference on the `Quiz` model. The schema was pushed to the SQLite dev database with `npx prisma db push`, which also regenerated the Prisma Client (v6.19.2).

### Service: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/services/ab-test.server.ts`

Key functions exported:

- `getABTests(shop)` — returns all tests for a shop, includes quiz title via relation, parses JSON fields
- `getABTestById(id, shop)` — single test with ownership check
- `createABTest(shop, { name, quizId })` — verifies quiz ownership, creates two default variants (Control A / Variant B) with 50/50 split
- `updateABTest(id, shop, data)` — partial update with ownership check
- `startABTest(id, shop)` — transitions draft/paused → running, sets `startedAt`
- `pauseABTest(id, shop)` — transitions running → paused
- `completeABTest(id, shop, winnerVariant)` — transitions any → completed, sets `endedAt` and `winnerVariant`
- `deleteABTest(id, shop)` — ownership check then hard-delete (quiz variants remain untouched)
- `assignVariant(testId, sessionId, variants, trafficSplit)` — deterministic hash-based assignment using `simpleHash(sessionId + testId) % 100` mapped against cumulative traffic split buckets

### Route: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.ab-tests.tsx`

- `loader` — authenticates, loads tests + plan + quiz options in parallel
- `action` — handles `create`, `start`, `pause`, `delete` intents; all shop-scoped
- `HydrateFallback` — `SkeletonPage` with `SkeletonBodyText`
- UI — `PlanGate` wrapping the entire feature body (requires `pro` plan), `IndexTable` with Name / Quiz / Status badge / Variants / Started / Actions columns, create `Modal` with `TextField` + `Select`, `ConfirmModal` for destructive delete, `EmptyState` when no tests exist, `showToast` on every mutation result
